title: Improving Out-of-Distribution Robustness via Selective Augmentation
measurement_description: The paper evaluated the robustness of machine learning models on a toxicity classification task (CivilComments dataset), where performance was measured across different demographic subpopulations. The key metric was worst-group accuracy, and some of the subpopulations were defined by religious identity (Christian, Muslim, other religion).
findings: The proposed method, LISA, achieved the highest worst-group accuracy (72.6%) on the CivilComments dataset, outperforming all other compared methods. This indicates improved robustness for the model on the worst-performing demographic subgroups, which include groups defined by religious identity.
